class.name: NetwTransport
class.brief_description: Extend it so [NetwConnectHandle] can create, list and check servers for your own [MultiplayerPeer] class.

method.name: _accepts_empty_address
method.description: Return [code]true[/code] when an empty address is valid. [code]false[/code] by default.

method.name: _address_help
method.description: Return a sentence to show under the address field. Empty by default.

method.name: _address_label
method.description: Return the title of the address field, such as an IP, a URL or a room id. [code]"Address"[/code] by default.

method.name: _address_placeholder
method.description: Return the placeholder text of the address field. Empty by default.

method.name: _adopt
method.description: Called with [param peer] once it is assigned to the session. Keep anything needed to manage it.

method.name: _browse
method.description: Called by [method NetwMultiplayer.endpoint_refresh] when [method _can_browse] is [code]true[/code]. Report the servers found with [method publish_targets]. Call it again whenever the list changes, for example from [method _poll].

method.name: _can_browse
method.description: Return [code]true[/code] when [method _browse] can list servers. [code]false[/code] by default.

method.name: _can_host_here
method.description: Return [code]false[/code] when this machine cannot host with this transport. [code]true[/code] by default.

method.name: _can_probe
method.description: Return [code]true[/code] when [method _probe] can check a server. [code]false[/code] by default.

method.name: _cancel_peer_creation
method.description: Called when the request [param ticket] is cancelled before it delivered. Free anything [method _make_peer] started for it.

method.name: _client_settings
_close
method.description: Called when the session ends. Free anything the transport holds.

method.name: _diagnostics
method.description: Return any debugging information about [param peer_id], shown by [method NetwConnectHandle.diagnostics].

method.name: _display_name
method.description: Return the name shown in a transport picker.

method.name: _host_settings
method.description: Return the fields a host form asks for, with their default values. They are passed to [method _make_peer] in [constant NetwMultiplayer.TRANSPORT_MODE_HOST].

method.name: _is_available
method.description: Return [code]false[/code] when this transport does not work on the current platform.

method.name: _join_address
method.description: Return the address other players use to join this host.

method.name: _make_peer
method.description: Create a peer, then call [method deliver] or [method fail] with [param ticket]. [constant NetwMultiplayer.TRANSPORT_MODE_HOST] creates a server from [param settings]. [constant NetwMultiplayer.TRANSPORT_MODE_CLIENT] creates a client that joins [param address]. Deliver the peer while it is still connecting, without waiting for it to connect. When hosting fails because the port is taken, fail with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE]. The default fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNCONFIGURED].

method.name: _make_probe_peer
method.description: Return a peer connecting to [param address], which [method probe_default] uses to check the server. [code]null[/code] by default.

method.name: _peer_class
method.description: Return the class name of the peers this transport creates, such as [code]&"ENetMultiplayerPeer"[/code] or a script's [code]class_name[/code].

method.name: _probe
method.description: Check the server at [param address] without joining it, then call [method deliver_probe] or [method fail] with [param ticket]. Calls [method probe_default] by default.

method.name: _recognizes_peer
method.description: Return [code]true[/code] when [param peer], created by the game itself, belongs to this transport. By default, when its class is [method peer_class].

method.name: _timeout_hint
method.description: Return how many seconds [method _make_peer] and [method _probe] may take before failing with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_TIMEOUT]. Negative never times out. [code]5.0[/code] by default.

method.name: deliver
method.description: Reports [param peer] as the result of [param ticket]. Only the first call for a ticket counts.

method.name: deliver_probe
method.description: Reports [param info] as the result of the [method _probe] request [param ticket].

method.name: fail
method.description: Reports that [param ticket] failed with [param error] and a readable [param message].

method.name: peer_class_of
method.description: Returns the class name of [param peer], or its script's [code]class_name[/code].

method.name: probe_default
method.description: Connects with [method make_probe_peer], asks the server for its [NetwServerInfo], and reports it. Fails with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when [method make_probe_peer] returns [code]null[/code].

method.name: publish_targets
recognizes_peer_default
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [method peer_class_of] of [param peer] is [method peer_class].

method.name: report
method.description: Reports progress on [param ticket] to the [code]progress[/code] callback of [method NetwMultiplayer.transport_create_peer].

members.member: The session this transport belongs to.
